summary: Retest of the iteration_109 bug in the InvoiceEditor Sel component (it now uses value={value || ""}). The bug is fixed. Steps: opened a fresh /fatture/nuova (placeholder 'Seleziona un cliente'), picked TEST_RetestA in the UI, filled the line and saved (1/2026). Clicking editor-new-invoice-btn goes to /fatture/nuova and the client select shows 'Seleziona un cliente' (PASS). Picked TEST_RetestB on that new form and saved, which worked (2/2026, party_id correct in the DB). Clicking editor-new-nc-btn goes to /fatture/nuova?tipo=TD04 with the NC badge, and the select shows 'Seleziona un cliente' (PASS). Regression: opening the saved invoice 2/2026 shows TEST_RetestB in the select. editor-copy-btn fills in the cliente TEST_RetestB and line 'TEST_riga B', and saving the copy created 3/2026 with the right party_id.
critical_code_review_comments: Still open from iteration_109 (not regressions): the !id reset effect depends only on [id, navigate], so moving between /fatture/nuova?tipo=TD04 and /fatture/nuova does not reset the form. The rr (rateo) state is not reset on navigation.
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST admin and company with `python ui_setup_t109.py setup 110110`, plus the clients TEST_RetestA and TEST_RetestB through the API. Everything was removed with `python ui_setup_t109.py clean 110110` (company, 3 invoices, the parties, the user and the session; verified 0 left).
